What is Life Insurance? Everything you need to know

The Basics of Life Insurance

1

What is Life Insurance?

Life insurance is a financial plan that gives a lump sum or regular payment to your family when the policy matures or if you pass away during the policy term — ensuring your income, your loans, and your family’s future goals are protected even in your absence. Some plans also build savings or generate regular income over time.

2

Why Choose IndusInd Nippon Life Insurance?

IndusInd Nippon Life Insurance (INLIC) has been protecting families for years — backed by IndusInd International Holdings Ltd. (IIHL) and Nippon, Japan. With a claim settlement ratio of 98.94%, 700+ branches, and 60,000+ advisors across India, we combine the reliability of a trusted insurer with the flexibility of a modern digital-first experience.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Life Insurance?

Life insurance is a financial plan that gives a lump sum or regular payment or the promised sum assured to your family or nominee when the policy matures or if the policyholder passes away unexpectedly. It helps secure your family’s financial future

Why Choose IndusInd Nippon Life Insurance?

IndusInd Nippon Life Insurance (INLIC) provides personalized life insurance plans with flexible options, competitive prices, and a reliable claim settlement ratio of 98.9%. We have a network of over 700+ branches across India and more than 68,000+ advisors.

What Types of Life Insurance Plans Are Available?

You can choose from term plans, endowment plans, Unit Linked Plans (ULIPs), retirement plans, and child education plans to fit your financial goals and protection needs.

How to Buy Life Insurance with IndusInd Nippon Life Insurance?

You can purchase policies online through our website, visit any IndusInd Nippon Life branch or give us your contact details so that we can reach out to you to help you make an informed decision.

What is Unit Linked Insurance Plan or ULIP?

Unit Linked Insurance Plans, generally called ULIP Plans, are investment-cum-protection plans that offer you dual benefits of availing market-linked returns on your investments, along with life insurance cover. You have the option to choose from a variety of funds available under the selected life insurance plans, along with the flexibility to manage and switch between funds. IndusInd Nippon Life Insurance presents you a wide range of regular and single premium Unit Linked Insurance Plan (ULIP) that suit your investment needs.

Are ULIPs good for wealth creation?

Yes, IndusInd Nippon Life ULIPs help you to grow your money over the long term through funds of different asset classes

How do fund switches work?

You can move your money between different funds easily. IndusInd Nippon Life ULIPs offer 52 free fund switches every year.

What is the lock-in period?

ULIPs have a 5-year lock-in, after which you can partially withdraw based on the plan rules.

Do ULIPs offer tax benefits?

Premiums paid to IndusInd Nippon Life ULIPs may qualify for tax deductions under prevailing laws. However, do consult a tax advisor before making any decision.

What payment options are available for premium payments?

Can I pay my insurance premium online securely?

How do I set up automatic premium payments (NACH)?

What happens if my premium payment fails?

If a payment fails, IndusInd Nippon Life notifies you and allows you to retry using any available payment mode. Your policy stays active during the grace period, so you can complete payment without losing benefits.

Yes, IndusInd Nippon Life accepts premium payments through popular UPI apps like Google Pay, PhonePe, and Paytm, making it fast and convenient.
